    return (d % P + P) % P

s = [0] * 7
p = [[] for _ in range(7)]
ans = 0

    global cnt, p
    cnt += 1
    p[d].append(m(cnt - v))

def calc(id, f):

    from bisect import bisect_left
    ps = bisect_left(p[id], P - f)
    return ((f * len(p[id]) + s[id] - P * (len(p[id]) - ps)) % mod)

def dfs1(d, v):
    global cnt, ans
    if v > n:
        return
    if d >= 1:
        if v * B > n // 10 and v * B + B - 1 <= n:
            t = 1
            for i in range(7):

            for i in range(7):

            return
        ans = (ans + m(cnt + 1 - v)) % mod
    for i in range(10) if d == 0 else range(10):
        dfs1(d + 1, v * 10 + i)
